intro: Line-by-line review of the repository as inherited (commit 3386a21), plus what this session changed. Findings are grouped by kind; nothing is asserted without a file path or an API result.
positives: Every previous session left a written record: COORDINATION.md is 18 KB and tracks claims, sources and handoffs across seven sessions.
Data files are structured JSON with explicit null/blank values rather than invented numbers — the right instinct for this brief.
The 24-row MICHELIN list in prior sessions matches the official Las Vegas MICHELIN page exactly (4 starred / 3 Bib / 17 Recommended).
Prior sessions correctly identified the two structural problems: no subway in Las Vegas, and the missing transit-time evidence.

rows.finding: Seven parallel sites all claimed to be the planner
rows.evidence: Root *.html (7 pages), docs/*.html (9 pages), docs/session-059c3126/, docs/session-2e5e3452/, docs/session-36cc5108/, docs/session-b29fc34e/, docs/session-d33551df/, docs/planner-v1/, legacy-dashboard/, field-notes/, site/*.html, site/session-b29fc34e/.
rows.action: Consolidated to one canonical root site (this session). All prior sites preserved untouched under docs/ and in git history. README now states which site is canonical.

rows.finding: Pages serves the repository root, not docs/, yet most prior work lives in docs/
rows.evidence: GET /repos/.../pages → {build_type: 'legacy', source: {branch: 'main', path: '/'}}. Prior READMEs described docs/ as the published site.
rows.action: Root site rebuilt as the canonical, mobile-first planner, so the URL people actually open is the good one. docs/ remains reachable at /docs/ and /<session>/ paths.

rows.finding: README is four READMEs stacked, with contradictory instructions and a factual error
rows.evidence: README.md repeats 'Rebuild' instructions for four different builders and says 'three starred restaurants' (official list: four).
rows.action: README rewritten as one document with one build command; the historical text is preserved in the Repo review page and git history. Error logged as F-19.

rows.finding: Four overlapping data trees with duplicated files
rows.evidence: data/*.json (14), data/verified/*.json (9), data/trip/*.json (9), field-notes/data/*.json (3); 2 files are byte-identical duplicates across trees.
rows.action: New canonical tree data/plan/ (9 files) used by the new build. Old trees left read-only as record.

rows.finding: Four CI workflows, three of which rebuild only a subtask
rows.evidence: .github/workflows/pages.yml (uploads docs/), pages-check.yml (rebuilds session-059c3126), validate.yml (session b29fc34e), validate-field-notes.yml (session 2e5e3452).
rows.action: Added .github/workflows/validate-plan.yml for the canonical site; existing workflows left intact so old outputs do not go stale.

rows.finding: Legacy dashboard duplicated at the root and in legacy-dashboard/
rows.evidence: legacy-dashboard/{index.html,data.js,app.js,styles.css} duplicates the first session's dashboard, which was also the v1 root pages.
rows.action: Kept as-is (historical). Not linked from the new site.

rows.finding: Prior root pages used emoji icons and inline nav duplicated per file
rows.evidence: Every previous root page carried its own <header> block with a hard-coded nav, and an emoji brand mark.
rows.action: Replaced by a single generated layout from scripts/build_plan.py with a shared nav and accessible skip link.

rows.finding: Unverified values were sometimes presented as facts in prose
rows.evidence: The inherited hotels.html stated 'roughly 15–20 minutes by car' travel times and a blanket 'all 24 restaurants reachable' claim without a transit source; this site's rule forbids that.
rows.action: Travel times removed or explicitly marked unverified. Ranking now uses a measurable, sourced measure (restaurants inside the same resort).

rows.finding: No automated link or source check existed for the root site
rows.evidence: Prior checkers (scripts/check_site.py, check_session_b29fc34e.py) cover only docs/ builds.
rows.action: scripts/check_plan.py validates every page, internal link, required source on every row, award counts (4/3/17) and blank-value discipline.

rows.finding: Open PRs #8 and #9 were never merged or closed
rows.evidence: GitHub PR list shows both OPEN since 2026-11-26.
rows.action: Left open (outside this session's scope); recorded in COORDINATION.md and F-21.

rows.finding: Coordination board's task table had drifted from reality
rows.evidence: Previous session marked 'verify table rows line-by-line' done while its own flag list recorded most rows unverified.
rows.action: This session split 'verified' from 'done' and records per-value capture dates.

rows.finding: Mobile tables in prior versions required horizontal scrolling
rows.evidence: Prior tables used overflow-x on 8+ columns with no stacking behaviour at narrow widths.
rows.action: New tables stack into labelled cards below 640 px (CSS data-label pattern), verified by the checker's markup test.

rows.finding: Two more sessions landed on main while this session was building, conflicting on the same five root pages
rows.evidence: origin/main advanced to 0d3e73e (PRs #19–#21, sessions 4831d710 and c5a8afb5) and modified index.html, hotels.html, restaurants.html, activities.html, flagged-for-review.html and COORDINATION.md.
rows.action: Merged main into this branch. This session's generated root pages kept as canonical; main's versions archived at docs/session-legacy-root/main-0d3e73e/ and COORDINATION.md keeps both records. Their two verified rate captures were incorporated (F-23).

rows.finding: Two sessions claimed the same file scope concurrently and both wrote data/plan/*.json
rows.evidence: git log shows PR #22 (session 155b420b) merged to main while session 4d7b292f was mid-research on the same paths. The live Pages site referenced booking.html and flagged.html, which did not exist in 4d7b292f's checkout at claim time. Merge produced add/add conflicts in data/plan/hotels.json, activities.json and booking.json.
rows.action: Resolved additively: 155b420b's schema kept as canonical; new verified values merged by scripts/merge_fieldwork_4d7b292f.py; both COORDINATION records retained. Recommendation: claims should be pushed AND re-checked against origin/main immediately before any write, not only at session start.

rows.finding: GitHub Pages source configuration and the Pages workflow disagree
rows.evidence: The Pages API reports build_type 'legacy' with source branch 'main' and path '/', so the checked-in REPOSITORY ROOT is what https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Vegas2/ serves. But .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads the 'docs' folder via actions/upload-pages-artifact and deploys it with actions/deploy-pages. Under the legacy source that artifact is not the served site.
rows.action: The canonical site is therefore correctly built at the root by scripts/build_plan.py. Prior-session notes claiming a subsite lives at '/session-<id>/' are wrong under this configuration — those folders resolve at '/docs/session-<id>/'. Either switch Pages to GitHub Actions as the source, or retire the misleading workflow. Left unchanged here because it is shared infrastructure outside this session's additive scope.

rows.finding: A prior session's validator fails on main because its official-domain allowlist is too narrow
rows.evidence: scripts/check_site.py reports 26 failures on origin/main @ 900cb90, independent of this session's changes (reproduced from a clean git archive of main). The failures are of two kinds: (a) genuinely official domains rejected by the allowlist, e.g. venetianlasvegas.com and rtcws.rtcsnv.com; (b) insecure http:// social links such as http://instagram.com/mypubliclands. Its own CI job is not gating main.
rows.action: Not fixed here: data/verified/ and scripts/check_site.py belong to session a52047d7 and are outside this session's additive scope. Requested change: add the official domains to the allowlist and upgrade those social links to https. The canonical root site is gated separately by scripts/check_plan.py, which passes with 0 failures.
